verdict.rationale: Asana's core product is task/project management, and its API docs (create tasks via API, automate work with rules/webhooks) plus community testimony describing it as a task/ticket management tool used like GTD-style workflows confirm core task creation and assignment functionality. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the standard UI flow for setting assignee and due date fields, and independent hands-on verification of that specific UI workflow.
